Definition: of Latin origin; illuminative; Lucius, a Christian:--Lucius.
BiblicalUsage: Loúkios means Lucius, a Christian, and the verse where it stands does the talking. In Romans 16:21, "and Lucius"; and in Acts 13:1, "and Lucius of Cyrene".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lucius of Cyrene is the proof the church was never one nation's — a prophet at Antioch and a kinsman greeted in Rome.
